starting_point.explanation: A typical bill at this stage with 72 days left, before looking at its other signals.

factors.factor: Sponsor's party controls the chamber where it started
Sponsor's party controls the other chamber
Has a matching bill in the other chamber

notes: Only 72 days are left in this Congress. If it doesn't pass both chambers by then, the bill dies and must be reintroduced.
Most bills never leave committee. Watch for a committee markup, which raises the odds sharply.

model_info.method: Logistic regression per stage, trained on every House and Senate bill in those Congresses.
